title: Tighten subtitle format policy matrix layout
summary: Tightened the Settings subtitle Format Policy Matrix so the format/type column stays compact and split-panel widths render the matrix as row cards instead of a wide fixed table.
reason: The matrix used equal-width fixed columns plus grid display on table row headers, which created dead space beside the subtitle type and caused the type/description text to wrap awkwardly in half-panel layouts.
behavior_before: The subtitle format row header behaved like a broken table/grid hybrid: the format column took too much space at wide widths and the label could collapse into narrow wrapped text in split-panel layouts.
behavior_after: The format column uses a compact fixed width on wide layouts. At split-panel widths the matrix becomes a two-column row-card layout with normal row-label casing and no document-level horizontal overflow.
tests_added: Added tests.webview.test_webview_css_design_tokens.WebViewCssDesignTokenTests.test_subtitle_policy_matrix_uses_split_panel_layout for the compact format column and split-panel CSS rules.
manual_validation: One-off Chrome/CDP half-panel layout probe at 949px Settings > Media Output -> OK; label width 152px, gap after label 32px, matrix row display grid, no document-level horizontal overflow.
